title: CLAT Entrance Preparation
tagline: Focused preparation for the Common Law Admission Test and admission to the National Law Universities.
overview: CLAT is the national entrance examination for admission to the undergraduate law programmes at the National Law Universities and several other law schools. The paper is comprehension-driven, testing English, current affairs and general knowledge, legal reasoning, logical reasoning and quantitative techniques. Coaching runs alongside the intermediate programme and pairs naturally with the CEC stream.
